srs: The document review system records Reviewer, Review, ReviewService, and Document; each has an id attribute. Each Reviewer can have zero or more Review records, and each Review belongs to exactly one Reviewer. Each Review uses exactly one ReviewService, and each ReviewService serves zero or more Review records. Each ReviewService manages one or more Document records by composition, and each Document belongs to exactly one ReviewService. Each Reviewer can reference zero or more Document records, and each Document can be referenced by zero or more Reviewer records.
